Quote from: Ruxandra on September 15, 2009, 02:12:36 PM
Moriarty, please don't be so harsh.

He just wanted to find out if people consider him worthy to be unbanned.

Dude, I want him to be unbanned. The only reason I'm being harsh is due to the fucking stupidity that's occurring here. And whether you like it or not I'm still going to be harsh.

That said this is what I gathered from this story:

Supericeboy and his friend came in the CS:S sever. His friend, for some reason that I don't know about, must have done something along the lines of a DDOS attack.

So from my guess, Super was banned TEMPORARILY to protect the server from his friend. So now Super takes it that he's fulfilling some sort of honor code by saying "I must protect the server! Sacrifice me!"

He's trying to find reasons for him to be banned, but it's stupid because this situation is irrelevant now.

There's no reason for this thread to be open. You can be unbanned any minute, you don't need to prove that you're worthy of being unbanned. In fact, he's not even doing that. It's a waste of everyone's time, and it's sure to get him a spot in the limelight for five minutes.
